title: Binary value of a Boolean list
statement: For a finite list of Booleans, define its value recursively by assigning the empty list value $0$ and assigning a list with first bit $b$ and remaining list $w$ the value $b+2\,\mathrm{value}(w)$, where false has value $0$ and true has value $1$.
hypotheses_covered: Input is a finite Boolean list
